templates.usage: Use when the agent completes multi-seller discovery across the IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry — render the returned inventory packages with pricing, reach, and audience data so the buyer can compare matching products from dozens of seller agents side by side.

Use when presenting the budget allocation step — show how an approved campaign budget is distributed across channels, publishers, and seller agents based on target KPIs and audience metrics, including post-negotiation reallocations.

Use immediately after human-in-the-loop approval triggers execution — display the frosted confirmation chip with the booked media buy ID and committed budget to confirm the OpenDirect 2.1 / Deals API order transacted successfully.

Use to render the append-only audit trail and campaign lifecycle milestones — brief structuring, discovery queries, negotiation rounds, approval gates, and line-item creation — as a chronological sequence for compliance review.

Use during in-flight campaign monitoring and optimization — show delivery KPI tiles with sparklines (impressions, spend, pacing, CPM) for booked media buys so the agent can justify pacing or budget shift recommendations.
